verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Tabaarakal-ladhee nazzalal-furqaana alaa abdihi liyakoona lil-aalameena nadheeraa
Al-ladhee lahu mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa lam yattakhidh waladan wa lam yakun lahu shareekun fil-mulki wa khalaqa kulla shay'in faqaddarahu taqdeeraa
Wattakhadhoo min doonihi aalihatan laa yakhluqoona shay'an wa hum yukhlaqoona wa laa yamlikoona li'nfusihim darran wa laa naf'an wa laa yamlikoona mawtan wa laa hayaatan wa laa nushooraa
Wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa ifkun iftaraahu wa a'aanahu alayhi qawmun aakharoona faqad jaa'oo zulman wa zooraa
Wa qaaloo asaateerul-awwaleena iktatabahaa fahiya tumlaa alayhi bukratan wa aseelaa
Qul anzalahul-ladhee ya'lamus-sirra fis-samaawaati wal-ardi innahu kaana ghafooran Raheemaa
Wa qaaloo maali haadhar-rasooli ya'kulut-ta'aama wa yamshee fil-aswaaqi lawlaa unzila ilayhi malakun fayakoona ma'ahu nadheeraa
Aw yulqaa ilayhi kanzun aw takoonu lahu jannatun ya'kulu minhaa wa qaalaz-zaalimoona in tattabi'oona illaa rajulan mashooraa
Unzur kayfa daraboo lakal-amthaala fadalloo falaa yastatee'oona sabeelaa
Tabaarakal-ladhee in shaa'a ja'ala laka khayran min dhaalika jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru wa yaj'al laka qusooraa
Bal kadhdhaboo bis-saa'ati wa a'tadnaa liman kadhdhaba bis-saa'ati sa'eeraa
Idhaa ra'athum min makaanin ba'eedin sami'oo lahaa taghayyuzan wa zafeeraa
Wa idhaa ulqoo minhaa makaanan dayyiqan muqarraneena da'aw hunaalika thubooraa
Laa tad'ul-yawma thubooran waahidan wad'oo thubooran katheeraa
Qul adhalika khayrun am jannatul-khuldil-latee wu'idal-muttaqoona kaanat lahum jazaa'an wa maseeraa
Lahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona khaalideena kaana alaa rabbika wa'dan mas'oolaa
Wa yawma yahshuruhum wa maa ya'budoona min doonillaahi fayaqoolu a'antum adlaltum ibaadee haa'ulaa'i am hum dallus-sabeel
Qaaloo subhaanaka maa kaana yanbaghee lanaa an nattakhidha min doonika min awliyaa'a wa laakin matta'tahum wa aabaa'ahum hattaa nasudh-dhikra wa kaanoo qawman booraa
Faqad kadhdhabookum bimaa taqooloona famaa tastatee'oona sarfan wa laa nasran wa man yazlim minkum nudhiqhu adhaaban kabeeraa
Wa maa arsalnaa qablaka minal-mursaleena illaa innahum laya'kuloonat-ta'aama wa yamshoona fil-aswaaqi wa ja'alnaa ba'dakum liba'din fitnatan atasbiroona wa kaana rabbuka baseeraa
Wa qaalal-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa lawlaa unzila alaynal-malaa'ikatu aw naraa rabbanaa laqadi istakbaroo fee anfusihim wa ataw utuwwan kabeeraa
Yawma yarawnal-malaa'ikata laa bushraa yawma'idhin lilmujrimeena wa yaqooloona hijran mahjooraa
Wa qadimnaa ilaa maa amiloo min amalin faja'alnaahu habaa'an manthooraa
Ashaabul-jannati yawma'idhin khayrun mustaqarran wa ahsanu maqeelaa
Wa yawma tashaqqaqus-samaa'u bil-ghamaami wa nuzzilal-malaa'ikatu tanzeelaa
Al-mulku yawma'idhin al-haqqu lir-Rahmaani wa kaana yawman alal-kaafireena aseeraa
Wa yawma ya'adduz-zaalimu alaa yadayhi yaqoolu yaa laytanee ittakhadhtu ma'ar-rasooli sabeelaa
Yaa waylatee laytanee lam attakhidh fulaanan khaleelaa
Laqad adallanee anidh-dhikri ba'da idh jaa'anee wa kaanash-shaytaanu lil-insaani khadhoolaa
Wa qaalar-rasoolu yaa rabbi inna qawmee ittakhadhoo haadhal-qur'aana mahjooraa
Wa kadhalika ja'alnaa likulli nabiyyin aduwwan minal-mujrimeena wa kafaa birabbika haadeean wa naseeraa
Wa qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lawlaa nuzzila alayhil-qur'aanu jumlatan waahidatan kadhaalika linuthabbita bihi fu'uaadaka wa rattalnaahu tarteelaa
Wa laa ya'toonaka bimathalin illaa ji'naaka bil-haqqi wa ahsana tafseeraa
Al-ladheena yuhsharoona alaa wujoohihim ilaa jahannama ulaa'ika sharrun makaanan wa adallu sabeelaa
Wa laqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba wa ja'alnaa ma'ahu akhaahu haaroona wazeeraa
Faqulnaa idhhabaa ilal-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa fadammarnaahum tadmeeraa
Wa qawma noohin lammaa kadhdhabur-rusula aghraqnaahum wa ja'alnaahum lin-naasi aayatan wa a'tadnaa liz-zaalimeena adhaaban aleemaa
Wa aadan wa thamooda wa ashaabar-rassi wa quroonan bayna dhaalika katheeraa
Wa kullan darabnaa lahul-amthaala wa kullan tabbarnaa tatbeeraa
Wa laqad ataw alal-qaryatil-latee umtirat mataras-saw'i afalam yakoonoo yarawnahaa bal kaanoo laa yarjoona nushooraa
Wa idhaa r'awka in yattakhidhoonaka illaa huzuwan ahadhal-ladhee ba'atha Allaahu rasoolaa
In kaada layudillunaa an aalihatinaa lawlaa an sabarnaa alayhaa wa sawfa ya'lamoona heena yarawnal-adhaaba man adallu sabeelaa
Ara'ayta manit-takhadha ilahahu hawaahu afa'anta takoonu alayhi wakeelaa
Am tahsabu anna aktharahum yasma'oona aw ya'qiloona in hum illaa kal-an'aam bal hum adallu sabeelaa
Alam taraa ilaa rabbika kayfa maddaz-zilla wa law shaa'a laja'alahu saakinan thumma ja'alnash-shamsa alayhi daleelaa
Thumma qabadnaahu ilaynaa qabdan yaseeraa
Wa huwal-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-layla libaasan wan-nawma subaatan wa ja'alan-nahaara nushooraa
Wa huwal-ladhee arsalar-riyaaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi wa anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an tahooraa
Linuhyiya bihi baldatan maytan wa nusqiyahu mimmaa khalaqnaa an'aaman wa anaasiyya katheeraa
Wa laqad sarrafnaahu baynahum liyadhdhakkaroo fa-abaa aktharun-naasi illaa kufooraa
Wa law shi'naa laba'athnaa fee kulli qaryatin nadheeraa
Falaa tuti'il-kaafireena wa jaahidhum bihi jihaadan kabeeraa
Wa huwal-ladhee marajal-bahrayni haadhaa adhbun furaatun wa haadhaa milhun ujaajun wa ja'ala baynahumaa barzakhan wa hijran mahjooraa
Wa huwal-ladhee khalaqa minal-maa'i basharan faja'alahu nasaban wa sihran wa kaana rabbuka qadeeraa
Wa ya'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa'uhum wa laa yadurruhum wa kaanal-kaafiru alaa rabbihi zaheeraa
Wa maa arsalnaaka illaa mubashshiran wa nadheeraa
Qul maa as'alukum alayhi min ajrin illaa man shaa'a an yattakhidha ilaa rabbihi sabeelaa
Wa tawakkal alal-hayyil-ladhee laa yamootu wa sabbih bihamdihi wa kafaa bihi bidhunoobi ibaadihi khabeeraa
Al-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wa maa baynahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin thumma istawaa alal-arshir-Rahmaanu faas'al bihi khabeeraa
Wa idhaa qeela lahum usjudoo lir-Rahmaani qaaloo wa mar-Rahmaanu anasjudu limaa ta'murunaa wa zaadahum nufooraa
Tabaarakal-ladhee ja'ala fis-samaa'i buroojan wa ja'ala feehaa siraajan wa qamaran muneeraa
Wa huwal-ladhee ja'alal-layla wan-nahaara khilfatan liman araada an yadhdhakkara aw araada shukooraa
Wa ibaadur-Rahmaanil-ladheena yamshoona alal-ardi hawnan wa idhaa khaatabahumul-jaahiloona qaaloo salaamaa
Wal-ladheena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjadan wa qiyaamaa
Wal-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa isrif annaa adhaaba jahannama inna adhaabahaa kaana gharaamaa
Innahaa saa'at mustaqarran wa muqaamaa
Wal-ladheena idhaa anfaqoo lam yusrifoo wa lam yaqturoo wa kaana bayna dhaalika qawaamaa
Wal-ladheena laa yad'oona ma'a Allaahi ilahan aakhara wa laa yaqtuloonan-nafsal-latee harrama Allaahu illaa bil-haqqi wa laa yaznoona wa man yaf'al dhaalika yalqa athaamaa
Yudaa'af lahul-adhaabu yawmal-qiyaamati wa yakhlud feehi muhaanaa
Illaa man taaba wa aamana wa amila amalan saalihan fa-ulaa'ika yubaddilu Allaahu sayyi'aatihim hasanaatin wa kaana Allaahu ghafooran Raheemaa
Wa man taaba wa amila saalihan fa-innahu yatoobu ilaa Allaahi mataabaa
Wal-ladheena laa yashhadoonaz-zoora wa idhaa marroo bil-laghwi marroo kiraamaa
Wal-ladheena idhaa dhukkiroo bi-aayaati rabbihim lam yakhirroo alayhaa summan wa umyaanaa
Wal-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa dhurriyyaatinaa qurrata a'yunin waj'alnaa lilmuttaqeena imaamaa
Ulaa'ika yujzawnal-ghurfata bimaa sabaroo wa yulaqqawna feehaa tahiyyatan wa salaamaa
Khaalideena feehaa hasunat mustaqarran wa muqaamaa
Qul maa ya'ba'u bikum rabbee lawlaa du'aa'uukum faqad kadhdhabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaamaa
